performance_claims.label: matched-real-online-tested-cell
performance_claims.scope: Qwen3.5 W8A8, two independent 5,000-request fixed-card replays with one output token
performance_claims.result: On two fixed-card synthetic near-duplicate replays with native APC disabled and one output token, throughput improved 20.39% and 18.78%; repeat TTFT p50/p95 fell 15.63%/11.27%. Card effects and answer quality remain unmeasured for this workload.

lifecycle.activation_contract: See the extension manifest and README; discovery alone does not enable this MOD. The enabled Qwen3.5 default is approximate tail_anchor; leave disabled or validate exact mode for accuracy-sensitive tasks.
lifecycle.rollback_contract: Disable the MOD and return to the unmodified host path.

out_of_scope: Accuracy guarantees from approximate KV reuse
